messages:
mara: FYI noticing ~2.8% of SSE streams from edge-proxy close after ~14s idle. clients reconnect immediately and we see duplicate token consumption. console shows no quota events. :confused:

josh: edge only or regional too?

mara: edge-proxy, mostly eu-west1. affects chat streams with short pauses.

devin: any proxy log sample?

mara: sample log: [edge-proxy] conn_id=abc123 route=/v1/chat/stream event=idle_timeout reason=keepalive_miss duration=14.2s upstream=200

sam: current proxy behavior is to FIN socket without sending SSE close frame. client treats as abrupt close and resumes as new session leading to double-charge.

josh: checked resume token TTL is still valid server-side, but proxy tombstones binding on FIN and routing treats reconnect as new session if resume header not attached immediately. race ~1-2s.

mara: options: 1) bump proxy idle to 30s (fast) 2) emit SSE ping/comment before closing (nicer) 3) make resume-token binding resilient (larger infra).

sam: prefer per-route policy instead of global idle increase. propose header X-Keepalive-Grace per-route default 30s for streaming endpoints. console should surface route grace window.

devin: need telemetry first: add metric sse_proxy_early_close{route,region,reason}. alert if >0.5% in 10m.

josh: i'll draft header schema and unit tests for proxy. keep canary small.

mara: i'll ship metric emit to staging and backfill 72h logs.

ops-bot: deploy queued: edge-proxy-metrics-v2 -> staging.
